result.title: Complexity-Calibrated Reconstruction Discrepancy for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment
result.summary: The discrepancy induced by surface reconstruction in a distorted point cloud is jointly influenced by its intrinsic structural complexity and signal degradation. This observation motivates a referencefree point cloud quality assessment (PCQA) strategy that estimates and compensates for the complexity-induced component. We implement this strategy through successive reconstruction. Specifically, reconstructing the distorted point cloud produces an input-toreconstruction discrepancy that combines the effects of signal degradation and content complexity. Reapplying the reconstruction operator with stronger smoothing produces a discrepancy between successive reconstructions, which serves as a proxy for the complexityinduced component. This proxy is then used to calibrate the inputto-reconstruction discrepancy. We apply the same strategy to 3D geometry patches and their aligned 2D regions, enabling local comparison of the resulting discrepancies. The calibrated geometric and projected-view discrepancies are then fused into a final degradation score. For both branches, the discrepancies are measured using frozen pretrained perceptual representations. Our method does not require PCQA-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on three public databases show that the proposed method consistently outperforms most generic baselines and achieves performance comparable to several full-reference metrics.The code is available at https://github.com/HC-W-whc/CCRD-NR-PCQA.git.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免参考点云质量评估方法：用连续重建产生的「输入-重建」差异刻画退化与内容复杂度混合效应，并以更强平滑的二次重建差异作为复杂度代理加以校准，再融合几何与对齐投影视图的差异得分，无需 PCQA 专用训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用冻结预训练感知表示度量差异，并把内容复杂度分量从退化信号中剥离，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 相似度或内部状态差异度量如何校正任务难度与内容复杂度造成的混杂。
